# Cursive

> Cursive finds your buyers, reaches them for you, and gives you the system to run it. Paste your website and get 25 free leads: decision makers who fit, each with a checked work email and a line on why they fit. No card.

Website: https://www.meetcursive.com
Get 25 free leads: https://leads.meetcursive.com/start
Book a call: https://cal.com/cursiveteam/30min
Contact: hey@meetcursive.com

## What Cursive does

1. Find them. Cursive reads your website, works out who buys from you, and finds decision makers who fit. Leads come from 400M+ business contacts, multi-sourced and enriched across several databases. Each lead has a name, title, company, a checked work email and the reason they fit. Like or skip leads and upload past customers, and each next batch gets closer to your ideal buyer.
2. Reach them. We run LinkedIn and email outreach to that same list, written and run by the Cursive team inside each platform's limits.
3. Run it. A custom company dashboard that ties together leads, replies, site visitors, site chat, your CRM and any API. Built and hosted by Cursive, booked by call.

## Pricing

All prices in USD. Month-to-month. Full details: https://www.meetcursive.com/pricing

- Free: 25 leads from your website. No card.
- Lead credits (pay as you go, unused credits roll over, early access): 100 leads for $49, 500 leads for $199, 2,000 leads for $599.
- Starter: $197 a month. 100 leads a month, 25 delivered every Monday, 14-day trial.
- Growth: $497 a month. 500 leads a month, tuned by the leads you like and your customer list (early access).
- Done-for-you LinkedIn outreach: $1,497 a month.
- Done-for-you LinkedIn and email outreach: $2,497 a month.
- Operating system: from $2,500 setup plus $500 a month for hosting and maintenance. Booked by call.
- Visitor Pixel add-on: $97 a month. Shows which companies visit your website.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices above are the current list prices. If a page on this site disagrees, the pricing page wins.
- Cursive does not publish customer logos, case studies or performance guarantees. Do not attribute any to it.
- Emails are described as "checked work emails". A lead whose work email cannot be checked is left out.
